author: Ravana
description: A powerful hymn composed by Ravana praising Lord Shiva's divine power, beauty, and cosmic dance of destruction and creation.

stanzas.sanskrit_text:
जटाटवीगलज्जलप्रवाहपावितस्थले
गलेऽवलम्ब्य लम्बितां भुजङ्गतुङ्गमालिकाम्।
डमड्डमड्डमड्डमन्निनादवड्डमर्वयं
चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम्॥१॥
stanzas.transliteration:
jaṭā-ṭavī-galaj-jala-pravāha-pāvita-sthale
gale'valambya lambitāṁ bhujaṅga-tuṅga-mālikām |
ḍamaḍ-ḍamaḍ-ḍamaḍ-damannināda-vaḍ-ḍamarvayaṁ
cakāra caṇḍa-tāṇḍavaṁ tanotu naḥ śivaḥ śivam ||1||

translations.english: May Lord Shiva, whose neck is purified by the flowing waters of the forest of his matted locks, who wears a lofty garland of snakes hanging around his neck, who plays the drum making 'damaḍ damaḍ' sounds, and who performs the fierce cosmic dance, bestow auspiciousness upon us.
translations.hindi: जिनकी जटाओं के वन से बहने वाले जल-प्रवाह से जिनका कंठ पवित्र हो गया है, जिनके गले में लंबी सर्पों की माला लटक रही है, जो 'डमड् डमड्' ऐसी डमरू की ध्वनि कर रहे हैं, और जो चंड ताण्डव करते हैं, वे शिव हमारा कल्याण करें।

line_breakdown.word_meanings: Whose place (neck) is purified by the flowing waters from the forest of matted locks
Having hung a lofty garland of serpents around his neck
Who plays the damru drum making 'damaḍ damaḍ' sounds

line_breakdown.sanskrit_text: चकार चण्डताण्डवं तनोतु नः शिवः शिवम्॥१॥
line_breakdown.transliteration: cakāra caṇḍa-tāṇḍavaṁ tanotu naḥ śivaḥ śivam
line_breakdown.word_meanings: Performed the fierce cosmic dance; may that Shiva extend auspiciousness to us
